from pyspark.sql.functions import col, dense_rank
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# 1. Garantir que a database gold existe
spark.sql("create database if not exists gold")

# 2. Definição do caminho base para a Gold de Armazém no ADLS Gen2
path_gold = "abfs://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/4. GOLD"

# 3. Leitura da tabela Silver de vehicle
df_gold_vh = spark.table("silver.tb_vh") 

# 4. Isolar registros únicos de vehicle e gerar a Surrogate Key (sk_wh)
window_vh = Window.orderBy("vehicle_id")

df_dim_vh = (
   df_gold_vh
   .select("vehicle_id","sensor_type")
   .distinct()
   .filter(col("vehicle_id").isNotNull())
   .withColumn("sk_vh", dense_rank().over(window_vh))
   .select("sk_vh","vehicle_id","sensor_type")
)

# 5. Gravação da dim_vh Delta na Gold

(df_dim_vh.write
     .format("delta")
     .mode("overwrite")
     .option("path",f"{path_gold}/dim_vh")
     .saveAsTable("gold.dim_vh")
